## All three stories — unlocked by the same tools

- GC-MS separates and identifies compounds from tiny, complex mixtures
- GC-EAD lets an insect's own antenna point to the biologically relevant
  ones
- From Fabre's moths, to Turlings' maize, to Kullenberg's orchids — the
  same chemistry toolkit cracked every case

::: {.notes}
Explicit callback tying the technology thread across all three stories.
~1 min.
